prompt: Create ONE separate book illustration of John, the real man in the photographic references, for The Vegetable Guru. Preserve his recognisable likeness: receding hairline with wispy short grey-brown hair at the sides, high forehead, short salt-and-pepper beard and moustache, gentle eyes, friendly understated smile, ordinary proportions. Faithful middle-aged-to-older adult face, not a caricature or generic garden mascot. Clothing follows the source: open muted red/cream/navy checked shirt, plain olive T-shirt, olive shorts; omit recording microphone and logos. Translate people, clothes, tools and plants into one coherent polished, dimensional vector-like drawn style governed by the approved vegetable hero references: bold simplified silhouettes, broad overlapping colour and shadow planes, natural skin colours, rich lime/forest foliage with sparse cream tapered highlights. No black contour outlines, no stippling, no etched/pencil texture, no watercolour, no photographic texture, no glossy plastic skin. Simplify shirt checks to broad clean lines. Keep hands anatomically plausible and natural, with readable finger grips. Show only a small garden/greenhouse vignette to establish context: a short section of bed, a few recognisable plants, perhaps part of a greenhouse frame. Surrounding space and gaps must be truly transparent, not white or dark haze. NO rectangular scene background, no sky or full greenhouse, no lettering, no border. Complete silhouette with clear padding on every side, no cropped head, elbows, tools or leaf tips. Large high resolution. Photo 1 supplies John’s face, body proportions and clothes. Photo 2 supplies a real young plant rootball and raised-bed growing setting. References 3–4 supply the approved drawn style. Create an honestly imagined gardening action using these sources: John kneeling next to a simple low wooden vegetable bed, carefully lowering a SMALL young leafy vegetable plant by its intact compact rootball into a prepared hole with both hands. Rootball supported underneath, not gripping the stem; open hole visible beneath. His face is recognisable in three-quarter profile, looking down, relaxed concentration. A small hand trowel rests on the soil beside him. Keep setting sparse, one short bed edge and two distant leaves, no big courgette or flowers, no dense foliage, no microscopic roots or soil texture. Complete silhouette, sensible limb proportions, all tools and shoes within frame, generous 8% transparent margin on every side. Landscape 3:2.
